display_name: 遮挡先验与 DURA 源波形互补诊断
description: 固定源先验和原 DURA，在 672 条源受损 IQ 上拼接遮挡先验输出，评估使用源 clean 的理想混合步长；不测试目标。

data.representation: 672 fixed source pilot received/clean paired IQ

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source clean masked reconstruction only; no deployable restoration or identity accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only masked IQ prior final epoch five and original DURA
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Prior and DURA source-only provenance verified; 32768 prior fit IDs disjoint from pilot
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed original DURA source-only provenance previously verified
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed DURA and prior final epoch; no target access

expected_artifacts: result.json: DURA and source-clean ideal-step IQ metrics

metric_names: source DURA and positive/signed ideal-step IQ NMSE
fraction positive improvement and negative ideal step
dimensions: RX4/6 and RX8 x seven source views x 48

rows.method: Eight 32-point masked predictions from DURA output, stitched interior; ideal clean-IQ step clipped to [0,0.5] or [-0.5,0.5]
rows.purpose: Test source IQ complementarity before defining deployable recovery version
rows.seed_notes: Five epochs, fixed final epoch; source pilot mask seed independent
rows.scenario: fixed source pilot RX4/6 and RX8 x seven simulated views
expected_artifacts: result.json: DURA and source-clean ideal-step IQ metrics

notes: No F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target IQ/truth; no parameter updates.
Each ideal step uses source clean and cannot be used in deployment; not an identity metric or general bound.
Pilot previously explored, not independent blind test.
Any deployable recovery version remains subject to full seven-view prediction and independent truth-last scoring.
